S.FORM: == pulingaw == a sicuayan a qinaljan nua se paiwan, namasan pazangal aravac a qiniladjan nua pulingaw, a pulingaw maqati a pasasedjalu tua caucau kata naqemati a cemas kata i selem a marka tja vuvu, aicu a pulingaw avan a pakeljakeljang tua varung nua cemas kata kai nua caucau tua cemas. a sika na masan pazangal aravac nua marka pulingaw i qinaljan, ayatua a pulingaw paljavak tua kina i kacauanan nua macidicidilj a caucau; kemasi tua sipualjak, a saqetju nua caucau, semu kuya semu paljiq, kisenai tua kina i kacauanan kata remukuz a pasa selem, neka nu inika kinicapilja a pusaladja nua marka pulingaw tua kina i kacauanan nua timaimanga a caucau. pai avan a sika namasan pazangal aravac a sengsengan a peniliq kata temulu tua seman pulingaw; a patagilj nua peniliq tua pulingaw kemasi tua kinacemkeljan nua kapulingavan a marka vuvu anga a pacun, tu izua auri namakeljangan tu sedjaljep a piliqen a seman pulingaw, izua nu pacun uta a piqinaljan tua uri sedjaljep a kisan pulingaw a vavayavayan a maqacuvucuvung. penenetj pai azua pinenetj tua uri san pulingaven a vavayavayan, izua pinakisumaljiyan tua si tavakan tu kisan pulingaw, inika maqati a pumaya a pacacikel i katjuruvuan i ta inika kinatavakan a kadjunangan; sipiliq uta tua kakanen, maru katjaukaizua a padai a kakesain i qinaljan, inika maqati a pakanan a uri masan pulingaw a caucau tua venli a kemasi pairang a padai, inika pakanan tua namacai anga kakanen a sacemel. azua pakitulutuluin ta pulingaw a maqacuvucuvung a vavayan kidjadjaladjalan nu kipusengsengan a pulingaw. lajkua nu vilivililjan anga nuri lemingdjen a seman pulingaw, pakivadaq anan a sema zaqu tua naqemati acemas kata marka vuvu sakana masalu. pai a pulingaw na kipapaulingaw saka namapukakudan aravac a sikudan, puvarung saka kedri aravac a kai, amin a kipusengsengan tua semu kuya tua caucau, semu siselapai ta qaljaqaljan, pucemel, kipasemalaw, kivadaq… a maretimaljimalji a sengsengan, papupicul kisenai tusika manguaqan suljivatjan nua kinaqinaljanan. == kaizuan ==
S.PHON: puɭiŋaw a siʦuajan a qinaʎan nua sə paiwan namasan pazaŋaɭ aravaʦ a qiniɭaɉan nua puɭiŋaw a puɭiŋaw maqati a pasasəɉaɭu tua ʦauʦau kata naqəmati a ʦəmas kata i səɭəm a marka ca vuvu aiʦu a puɭiŋaw avan a pakəʎakəʎaŋ tua varuŋ nua ʦəmas kata kai nua ʦauʦau tua ʦəmas a sika na masan pazaŋaɭ aravaʦ nua marka puɭiŋaw i qinaʎan ajatua a puɭiŋaw paʎavak tua kina i kaʦauanan nua maʦidiʦidiʎ a ʦauʦau kəmasi tua sipuaʎak a saqəcu nua ʦauʦau səmu kuja səmu paʎiq kisənai tua kina i kaʦauanan kata rəmukuz a pasa səɭəm nəka nu inika kiniʦapiʎa a pusaɭaɉa nua marka puɭiŋaw tua kina i kaʦauanan nua timaimaŋa a ʦauʦau pai avan a sika namasan pazaŋaɭ aravaʦ a səŋsəŋan a pəniɭiq kata təmuɭu tua səman puɭiŋaw a patagiʎ nua pəniɭiq tua puɭiŋaw kəmasi tua kinaʦəmkəʎan nua kapuɭiŋavan a marka vuvu aŋa a paʦun tu izua auri namakəʎaŋan tu səɉaʎəp a piɭiqən a səman puɭiŋaw izua nu paʦun uta a piqinaʎan tua uri səɉaʎəp a kisan puɭiŋaw a vavajavajan a maqaʦuvuʦuvuŋ pənənəc pai azua pinənəc tua uri san puɭiŋavən a vavajavajan izua pinakisumaʎijan tua si tavakan tu kisan puɭiŋaw inika maqati a pumaja a paʦaʦikəɭ i kacuruvuan i ta inika kinatavakan a kaɉunaŋan sipiɭiq uta tua kakanən maru kacaukaizua a padai a kakəsain i qinaʎan inika maqati a pakanan a uri masan puɭiŋaw a ʦauʦau tua vənɭi a kəmasi pairaŋ a padai inika pakanan tua namaʦai aŋa kakanən a saʦəməɭ azua pakituɭutuɭuin ta puɭiŋaw a maqaʦuvuʦuvuŋ a vavajan kiɉaɉaɭaɉaɭan nu kipusəŋsəŋan a puɭiŋaw ɭajkua nu viɭiviɭiʎan aŋa nuri ɭəmiŋɉən a səman puɭiŋaw pakivadaq anan a səma zaqu tua naqəmati aʦəmas kata marka vuvu sakana masaɭu pai a puɭiŋaw na kipapauɭiŋaw saka namapukakudan aravaʦ a sikudan puvaruŋ saka kəɖi aravaʦ a kai amin a kipusəŋsəŋan tua səmu kuja tua ʦauʦau səmu sisəɭapai ta qaʎaqaʎan puʦəməɭ kipasəmaɭaw kivadaq a marətimaʎimaʎi a səŋsəŋan papupiʦuɭ kisənai tusika maŋuaqan suʎivacan nua kinaqinaʎanan kaizuan
